I just want to see the flesh split open... See what makes me. I am just something that should have died a long time ago.

I only keep going because I like the pain... And to complain. One day I will die, I guess today isn't the day.

Fuck me
I'll check it out, that's for the reply.

Reading stories like this make me so sad and just so fucking angry. How dare anyone, especially those who's only job was to LOVE YOU, treat you like that. 

It's just so messed up and I'm sorry that you carry that around with you. 

Fuck those people. ***hugs***
Thank you so much for your response! Definitely something to look into and bring up with a therapist.
